LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Kalasiris.label: kalasiris
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Kalasiris.description: A long sheath dress of pleated linen with a broad beaded collar. Cool in the worst heat and handsome at court.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Corselet.label: scale corselet
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Corselet.description: A leather corselet covered in overlapping bronze scales, made for charioteers who need their arms free to shoot.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khepresh.label: khepresh war crown
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khepresh.description: A tall war crown of blue-dyed leather studded with bronze discs, worn by chariot captains. It turns a glancing blow and is seen across a battlefield.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Nemes.label: nemes
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Nemes.description: The striped royal headcloth with lappets falling to the chest and a gold cobra at the brow. Only the king and his heir may wear it.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LeopardMantle.label: leopard mantle
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_LeopardMantle.description: A leopard skin worn over a white linen robe, the mark of the high priest who reads the stars and the sun calendar.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_FieldCoat.label: Kemetic field coat
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_FieldCoat.description: A light khaki coat for the desert sun, a turquoise collar echoing the old broad collar and a leather shoulder strap.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SteelHelmet.label: Kemetic sun helmet
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_SteelHelmet.description: A light steel helmet in sand colour with a linen cloth hanging over the neck against the sun, and a gold falcon on the front.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_FieldUniform.label: Kemetic desert uniform
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_FieldUniform.description: A light sand tunic with a turquoise collar, bronze buttons and breast pockets, cut loose for the heat.
